description: Input: the same fields as quote_ugc, plus attempt. Make an ad, a UGC video or a product video in which a presenter talks to the camera, from a script: a lip-synced video with an actor, a voice, captions, music, templates, moves, inserts and live shots. The actor is actor_id, image or the default. Format and resolution follow the request and the source, defaulting to 720x1280. Captions are off unless captions=true. Poll get_run with its poll.arguments; a failed run whose video is still being made can return to queued, named in warnings[]. attempt=2,3,… starts a new run. A video like a reference reel: plan_reference_remake with its analysis_id instead. With no templates, moves (list_moves) or live shots (shots) on its words, the video is the presenter talking. Price: starting at 10 credits per second the presenter is in the video, covered or not, by presenter engine, plus production (voice and render) 1 credits per second of video, at least 50; list_prices names each engine and add-on. Quote first with quote_ugc.
name: make_ugc
title: Make a talking-actor video
